editorialPolicy: AARAMORA is a multilingual discovery catalogue. It links to official sources and records language scope, access model, provenance, accessibility notes and item-level rights caveats. It does not mirror copyrighted books, scrape restricted sites, bypass access controls or treat a collection-level statement as a book-level licence. Language filters are discovery aids, not a guarantee that a linked source contains every listed language. Every edition-level record carries an explicit review state. A source page check is not a native-language, clinical, religious/cultural, legal or assistive-technology approval. Each record now carries format tags for book, video, audiobook, article, blog or image discovery. Tags describe the linked source, not AARAMORA-hosted copies. Video, audio, articles, blogs and images retain creator- and item-specific rights. Do not bulk scrape platforms, bypass DRM/paywalls or treat free-to-read links as redistribution permission. Audio is distinct from audiobooks: audio denotes podcasts, recitations, guided practices and general audio media; audiobook denotes a narrated book or complete audio-book edition. Format tags describe linked source material, not AARAMORA-hosted copies.
